Be it Ordained by the City Council of the City of Chicago:


SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing the current B3-1
Community Shopping District as shown on Map 1 l-VI in the area bounded by:

       The public alley north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; North Marmora Avenue;
       West Irving Park Road; and a line 175.00 Ret west of and parallel to North Marmora
       Avenue,

to those of a CI-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common Address:       5900 West Irving Park Road
